title: Bootleg Sampler
overview:
Playable bits and video clips

Includes playable samples and video clips of Sega Saturn games.

An official Sega sampler disc, not for resale, despite its name. Try out playable demos of games such as Sega Rally Championship, Clockwork Knight 2, World Series Baseball and Bug!, then watch video previews of more Saturn titles. Games featured on the packaging include Virtua Fighter 2, Virtua Cop, Panzer Dragoon, Daytona USA, Mystaria, Wing Arms and NHL All-Star Hockey. Contents vary slightly between versions of the disc.

- Playable demos and video clips
- Features music by the Bygone Dogs
